label: Guardian Jobs
terms_note: Madgex-run board; apply via form or employer link.

endpoints.notes: RSS `item`: title ("EMPLOYER: Job title"), description (salary + employer + summary), location, link (`/job/<id>/<slug>/?TrackID=8&utm_source=rss`), pubDate, guid

endpoints.purpose: not offered — apply is a logged-in profile action (`/apply-profile/`, disallowed in robots.txt) or a redirect to the employer

reference.limits: Not published. - Terms and conditions (jobs.theguardian.com/terms-and-conditions/) carry no bot / scraping / automation clause; robots.txt disallows `/apply-profile/` and everything for unlisted agents (`Disallow: /`), so feed consumption should use the RSS URL only. - Automated applying is not addressed; the apply lane stays assist (user clicks submit).

search.note: Guardian Jobs job-board RSS (Madgex, RSS 2.0, 20 postings per page). keywords is the board's own search-box parameter (the feed of any search is the search URL under /jobsrss/) and page selects further pages of 20 (checked 2026-09-25: keywords narrows the feed; page=2 returns the next 20, an exhausted page returns an empty channel). location, remote and limit are not sent (location filtering on these boards uses internal location ids). title is 'Employer: Job title' and description begins with the salary line, so company and salary are not split out. id is the posting link.

not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none'): the feed is public and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: The feed has no per-item endpoint (each posting's url is an HTML page); search returns the whole record in raw.
not_offered.apply: No application endpoint: the feed only lists postings; candidates apply on each posting's url (employer page / e-mail).
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the only machine-readable interface is the public job feed.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
